title: BanglaMFSReceiptSchema
description: Schema for extracting span-grounded key information from Bangla Mobile Financial Services receipts (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Cellfin).

mfs_provider.description: MFS platform name (bKash/বিকাশ, Nagad/নগদ, Rocket/রকেট, Upay/উপায়)

transaction_type.description: Type of transaction (Send Money, Cash Out, Merchant Payment, Mobile Recharge, Bill Pay)

sender_number.description: Source phone / wallet number (often masked or standard 11 digits)

recipient_number.description: Destination phone / merchant / agent wallet number

recipient_name.description: Name of recipient / merchant if present

amount.description: Base transaction amount transferred/paid in BDT

charge_fee.description: Transaction convenience / service charge in BDT

total_amount.description: Total amount debited from sender wallet in BDT

reference.description: User reference text or transaction memo
